title: Update proposal copy for Bhoomi and remove music/photo/personalization UI

requirements.text:
Update the initial proposal screen copy to use a fixed greeting and fixed message text (no user-editable fields): change the greeting to exactly “Hey Bhoomi,” and insert the following message text immediately before the “Will you be my Valentine?” question:

ni tu ikk vaari keh de ke,
"mai teri aan"
dekhin,'taarun kiven mull tere pyar da

quotes: instead of hey beautiful i need , hey bhoomi, then i need this message to be there"ni tu ikk vaari keh de ke,"mai teri aan"dekhin,'taarun kiven mull tere pyar da", before will u be my valentine

acceptanceCriteria: On the initial screen, the headline displays exactly “Hey Bhoomi,” (including the comma).
The provided message text appears between the greeting and the “Will you be my Valentine?” line.
The “Will you be my Valentine?” text remains present and has no trailing emoji.
There are no inputs or settings that change the name/message/affirmation used in the proposal text.

requirements.text: Remove the personalization UI and related state so the page no longer shows any fields such as “Her Name”, “Personal Message”, or “Affirmation”, and the proposal uses only the fixed copy.

quotes: no personalised mssg for her ok

acceptanceCriteria: The personalization card/section is not rendered on the page.
No text inputs for name/message/affirmation are visible.
The proposal and success screens do not reference or display user-provided name/message/affirmation values.

requirements.text: Remove background music functionality and UI from the page (including playback controls), so nothing related to music appears in either the initial or success screens.
acceptanceCriteria: No music controls (play/pause, mute, volume slider, or “Background Music” label) are rendered on any screen.
The app does not initialize or use the local audio hook for background music.

requirements.text: Remove the girlfriend corner photo from the UI so no personal photo/picture is displayed on either the initial or success screens.
acceptanceCriteria: No corner image/photo is rendered on any screen.
No broken-image placeholder appears in the corner areas where the image previously displayed.

constraints: Frontend changes must not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep the existing single-page flow and existing Yes/No interaction behavior unless it directly conflicts with the copy/photo/music removals.
nonGoals: Adding any background music support or audio asset instructions.
Reintroducing personalization inputs or any customizable message/name/affirmation fields.
Backend changes (backend is not needed for these updates).
